arguments.sql: SELECT m.mcc, c.description, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions t JOIN merchants m ON t.merchant_id = m.id LEFT JOIN mcc_codes c ON m.mcc = c.mcc GROUP BY m.mcc, c.description ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, m.mcc ASC LIMIT 3
arguments.explanation: This returns the three merchant category codes that have the most transactions, from highest to lowest, with each code's description and transaction count.
assumptions: All transactions are counted, whether or not they have a fraud label and including negative amounts and those with errors.
If two codes have the same count, the lower code number comes first.
